violations.text: Observed two shelves in the (front counter area) constructed of material that is not smooth, durable and non-absorbent. Materials shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces: -fan covers in walk-in coolers and walk-in freezer -non-food contact surface of slicer have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

A hose is connected to the faucet at the (mop sink). This faucet is lacking a backflow prevention device. An approved backflow prevention device is required in order to prevent backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply at each point of use at a food establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Sliced cheese was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Date marking slips created at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/11/2025

Tuna Salad and cream cheese items that are prepared on site was observed marked with a date exceeding 7 days from the date of preparation. TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 41ºF or less for a MAXIMUM of 7 days. (Items observed were prepared within 7 days of inspection.) New Violation. Correct By: 01/29/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of shelving where clean equipment is stored was observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris. Non-FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. New Violation. Correct By: 01/31/2024

The dumpster outside is located on Grass. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2024
